description: This file defines the ProfileReader class responsible for retrieving user profile data, including follow status, from the database within the Conduit feature set. It interacts with the database context, performs entity-to-DTO mapping, and handles errors such as not found scenarios.

classes.name: ProfileReader
classes.description: A class that reads and constructs profile data for users, including follow status, based on username input and current user context.

methods.name: ReadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the profile information for a specified username, includes follow relationship status if applicable, and handles not found errors.
